rows.role_title: National President of the Bahujan Samaj Party
rows.text: The party's letter to the Chief Election Commissioner dated 16-7-2012, 'Subject: Updated List of Office Bearers of Central Unit, BSP-Reg.', is written on the letterhead of 'Km. Mayawati, National President' and signed '(MAYAWATI)'; the enclosed 'Latest list of office bearers and members of the Central Executive Committee Bahujan Samaj Party' gives '1. Km. Mayawati' with the designation 'National President'.
